sources.snippet: Introduction October 2025 saw a wave of open-source OCR model releases. sources.title: Local LLM PDF OCR - GitHub
sources.snippet: Local LLM PDF OCR moves beyond traditional Tesseract-based scanning. By pointing it at an OCR Vision Language Model (VLM) like olmOCR, Qwen3-VL, or GLM-OCR running locally, it reads documents with human-like understanding — then writes an invisible, selectable text layer back under the original image.
